briefing.headline: DeepSeek-R2 and OpenAI o4 escalate AGI race as multi-agent systems proliferate

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Global AI competition intensifies with frontier labs releasing advanced models weekly. US-China tensions drive record compute investments while regulatory scrutiny grows.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek-R2 matches GPT-5 level performance at lower cost, while xAI deploys Grok-4.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New red-teaming benchmarks highlight persistent multi-agent risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to Microsoft and Google; TSMC accelerates 2nm production for AI chips. Stargate Phase 2 data centers reach 100k H100 equivalents online.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models from China close the capability gap with closed US labs by end of 2026?
